messages:
jamie: FYI starting coordinated apply for release/v2.7 in ~30m. plan looks big, want to land infra gating before app cut.
rachel: Ok. Can we do a tiered apply? infra-network -> infra-iam -> infra-apps. That way we can verify routing before role changes.
pavan: +1 on tiers. Also propose provider pin to 3.73 across the run to avoid drift; we tested 3.73 on staging.
marc: If we pin, document hotfix path: provider unpin -> apply small module -> re-pin. We don't want surprise provider upgrades.
jamie: Agreed pin 3.73 for the window. deploybot: queued: multi-slot apply (tiered). preflight running.
deploybot: preflight results:
 - state lock: OK
 - drift: none except a stale route53 TXT in prod-canary
 - provider constraints: found local pin 3.73, remote repo suggests 3.74 available
 - tf validate: OK
rachel: That TXT drift is from legacy cert renewal. Not blocking but note in release notes.
opsbot: alert: scheduled change window 2026-03-15 18:00 UTC — will silence non-essential alerts.
jamie: Rollback rules: immediate rollback if any of these during canary window: app deploy fails >1 host, IAM policy attach errors, or route53 propagation failures for >2 minutes.
pavan: Also require manual signoff from network owner before iam tier. No auto-apply for iam replacements.
marc: Plan snippet pasted:
```
# module.network.aws_route53_record.web: 1 to change
# module.iam.aws_iam_policy_attachment.service_policy: 0 to change
# module.iam.aws_iam_role.app-role: ~> replacement planned
```
marc: Looks like `app-role` replace is in the plan. That triggers manual path per pavan.
jamie: Action: deploybot run `tier-1` (network) now. `tier-2` (iam) is on hold with tag `hold:iam-replace`. deploybot: starting tier-1 apply slot 174555-A. logs -> https://deploybot/logs/174555-A
deploybot: tier-1 success. route53 TXT updated, no propagation errors.
rachel: Watching metrics and dns propagation. all good so far.
marc: I will prepare role-swap playbook steps in case we need manual rotation. dropping link: https://runbooks.internal/role-swap
pavan: Update release notes: "IAM changes in us-east-1 require manual role-swap, iam tier held pending operator. Network tier completed." Pinning notes to channel.
jamie: Good. After we validate canary (tenant-beta) for 10 minutes, if stable we will request network owner signoff and then proceed to runbook-guided iam handoff.
opsbot: monitor-silence enabled for release window. non-critical alerts suppressed for 20m.
rachel: Canary metrics 10m: errors 0.1%, p95 stable, dns propagation within 30s.
marc: role-swap team ready. tagging `oncall-network` and `oncall-iam`.
jamie: Closing tier-1 as complete. Keeping thread open for tier-2 manual step. please escalate here if anything comes up. :handshake:
